fields.name: SetToDefaults
documentation: Restricts resetting this object to a default state. Implied automatically when any other forbidden aspect is set.

fields.name: ScriptBindings
documentation: Restricts querying, replacement, or hooks of scripts on this object.

fields.name: UntrustedScriptExecution
documentation: Restricts execution of all scripts for this object. Propagates to any children of this object.

fields.name: UntrustedLayoutScriptExecution
documentation: Restricts execution of layout scripts (eg. OnSizeChanged) for this object. Propagates to any children of this object, and anything anchored to to this object.

fields.name: EventRegistrations
documentation: Restricts querying or modifying registered script events for this object.

fields.name: AlwaysPropagateInput
documentation: Forces propagation of mouse and keypress input for this object. Propagates to any children.

fields.name: ScriptedInput
documentation: Restricts APIs that trigger synthetic input interactions on objects from Lua scripts.

fields.name: QueryFocus
documentation: Restricts APIs that query input focus state.

fields.name: ChangeAnimationTarget
documentation: Restricts APIs that can change the target object of an animation.

fields.name: RemoveSecretAspects
documentation: Restricts APIs that clear secret aspects from objects.

fields.name: ChangeParent
documentation: Restricts APIs that change the parent of an object.

fields.name: SetTexture
documentation: Restricts APIs that set the texture on a texture object.

fields.name: QueryRotation
documentation: Restricts APIs that query texture rotation.

fields.name: QueryAnimationProgress
documentation: Restricts APIs that query the progress or state of animations.

fields.name: AddAnimations
documentation: Restricts APIs that add animations to animation groups.
